name: Web Fonts Loader – Google Fonts Manager
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Elevate your WordPress site with access to the complete range of Google Fonts for enhanced typography and design.

The Web Fonts Loader plugin lets you access and manage Google Fonts, apply global typography settings, and enhance your site’s performance and design.

It’s perfect for anyone looking to elevate their site’s typography with a wide selection of high-quality fonts.

USAGE

Once you have successfully installed and activated the Web Fonts Loader plugin, your Classic Editor toolbar will be enhanced with two new dropdown menus containing all the available font options.

Editor Toolbar Customization:

  • Font Typeface Selection: The first dropdown in your editor toolbar lets you select the font family. Browse through a variety of Google Fonts to find the perfect match for your content.
  • Font Weight and Style Selection: The second dropdown is for font weight and style. Choose from various font weights (from Thin to Black) and styles, including italic versions.

Applying Fonts Site-Wide:

Go to Web Fonts Loader in your WordPress admin submenu.

This section lets you apply your chosen fonts universally across your site.

Select fonts for your site’s headings and body text to create a consistent and cohesive design.

Tips for Optimal Use:

  • Experiment with Combinations: Try different font families, weights, and styles to find what best suits your site’s design.
  • Preview Changes: Always preview your changes to see how the fonts look in real-time.
  • Maintain Consistency: Consistent font usage ensures a professional and cohesive web design.

By following these tips, you can enhance the visual appeal and readability of your WordPress site with the Web Fonts Loader plugin.

Enjoy transforming your website’s typography!

FEATURES & LIMITATIONS

  • Typography Presets Library (NEW in 1.6): Browse ready-to-use font combinations expertly designed for different styles. Quickly apply professional typography with one click and preview fonts before applying them to your site.
  • Font Performance Monitoring (NEW in 1.6): Track your font loading performance with real-time metrics. Get optimization scores (0-100) and actionable recommendations to improve site speed. See estimated font sizes and weight counts at a glance.
  • Dashboard Widget (NEW in 1.6): Monitor typography statistics directly from your WordPress dashboard. View active fonts, Google Fonts count, system fonts, and performance metrics in a compact 2-column layout for quick insights.
  • Onboarding Experience (NEW in 1.6): New users receive a welcoming notice with quick links to configure settings and access documentation, making the initial setup smooth and intuitive.
  • Extensive Font Selection: Access a wide array of font variations and styles, including weights from 100 to 900, italics, and more. This feature allows you to precisely tailor the typography to match your website’s unique style.
  • Customizable for Every Element: Style headings, blockquotes, and other elements with your chosen fonts. The flexibility to apply fonts to specific page or post elements via the editor (currently compatible with the Classic Editor) enhances your control over site design.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Customize the font typeface, weight, and style of your page or post content with just a few clicks. The plugin’s interface is designed for ease of use, catering to both beginners and experienced users.
  • Dynamic Font Loading: Utilize the Web Fonts Loader by Typekit to load fonts dynamically on a post/page basis. This means you can use different fonts on different pages, and only the fonts applied will load on the front-end, ensuring efficient performance.
  • Performance-Oriented: The lightweight design ensures that loading fonts on the front end does not affect your page’s loading speed. Now with built-in performance monitoring to track and optimize font usage.
  • Expansive Font Families and Variations: Choose from popular font families like Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, and more, along with their variations such as Roboto Condensed, Open Sans Condensed, and Montserrat Alternates.
  • Rich Font Weights and Styles: Select from a comprehensive range of font weights (Thin to Black) and styles (including various italic options), offering unparalleled customization options.
  • Responsive and Cross-Browser Compatibility: Ensures a consistent and responsive typography experience across different devices and browsers. All new features are fully responsive and mobile-optimized.
  • Regular Updates and Support: Stay up-to-date with the latest font trends and receive dedicated support for any queries or assistance.

Ideal for: This plugin is ideal for anyone looking to elevate their website’s typography, whether for improved readability, enhanced brand identity, or to create a more visually appealing design. The Web Fonts Loader plugin provides the tools needed for a complete typographic makeover, now with performance insights and ready-to-use presets.

DETAILED DOCUMENTATION

Find step-by-step setup guides, usage instructions, demos, videos, and insights on the Web Fonts Loader Pro page.

WEB FONTS LOADER PRO

If you’re using the free version from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Web Fonts Loader Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • Google Developer API integration.
  • Manage Global Fonts and add custom rules.
  • Font Manager feature to delete, download, and @import any fonts.
  • Block editor support alongside Classic Editor integration.
  • Load custom fonts locally to comply with EU/GDPR guidelines and boost website performance.
  • User-defined Google Fonts, system fonts, and Gutenberg blocks.
  • Include Google italic fonts and select supported subsets.
  • Font usage summary, report generation, and reset options.
  • Priority support and regular updates for one year included in Web Fonts Loader Pro.
sections.installation:
The plugin installation is easy and straightforward. Let us know if you run into any issues.

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Web Fonts Loader.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Click Settings or go to Web Fonts Loader in the menu.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the developry-google-fonts folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Go to Plugins.
  3. Activate the Web Fonts Loader plugin.
  4. Click Settings or navigate to Web Fonts Loader in the menu.

After Activation

  1. Select global fonts from Web Fonts Loader.
  2. Edit any Post or Page using the Classic Editor to access additional options for font family and weight in the toolbar.
sections.faq:
Visit the Support page to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

Is WordPress Gutenberg Block Compatibility Available?

Currently, the plugin does not support Gutenberg blocks. However, you can explore Web Fonts Loader Pro, which offers this functionality and more.

If you prefer to use the plugin, you can still do so by using the Classic Editor or setting global fonts through the plugin’s options page.

How to Apply a Font Family or Weight to All Text on a Specific Page or Post?

To apply a specific font family or weight, select your desired option without highlighting any text in the editor.

Applying Fonts to a Lead Paragraph or Heading

To apply a font to a specific paragraph or heading, double-click on the text of the element. This will select the entire text, allowing you to assign your desired font family or weight.

Identifying the Font Family or Weight on an Element

To identify the font family or weight applied to an element, click on it once. If a Google font family or weight is applied, the Toolbar options will display the details.

Applying Font Family or Weight Site-Wide

Go to Appearance > Web Fonts Loader in your WordPress admin menu. There, you’ll find all the settings needed for global font application.

Note: Applying fonts and styles to individual elements through the Classic Editor will override global font settings.

1.6.0

  • New – Typography Presets Library with ready-to-use font combinations
  • New – Font Loading Performance Metrics with optimization score and recommendations
  • New – Dashboard Widget showing font statistics and performance at a glance
  • New – Onboarding Welcome Notice for new users with quick setup guide
  • New – Pro Table component for showcasing premium features
  • Enhancement – Modular SCSS architecture with separate feature folders (dashboard-widget, presets, font-performance, onboarding-notice)
  • Enhancement – Optimized CSS with color variables and sass:color.adjust() for dynamic variants
  • Enhancement – Unified design system using shared component styles across all features
  • Enhancement – All spacing and sizing values converted from rem to px for consistency
  • Enhancement – Improved responsive layouts for mobile devices
  • Enhancement – Enhanced color scheme using existing plugin color palette
  • Update – WPCS-compliant code formatting throughout
  • Update – Improved code organization and file structure
  • Update – Language file support moved to /languages directory
  • Fix – Removed all debugging code (console.log, error_log, var_dump)
  • Fix – Code optimization and cleanup for production readiness

1.5.3

  • New – Add WP pointer to inform first time users about global Google Fonts integration
  • Update – Language file (.pot)
  • Update – Language file (.pot) header text

  • Fix – Add proper sanitization missing for register_setting()
  • Fix – Added stricter nonce verification using check_admin_referer() and check_ajax_referer() instead of manual checks; Introduced capability checks (current_user_can( 'manage_options' )) before allowing dismiss or update actions; Ensured unauthorized users cannot bypass dismissal or settings updates

  • Update – Remove the bitly.com links with raw and direct links with analytics params
  • Fix – Notice translation loading for the developry-google-fonts domain was triggered too early

  • Update – Development env setup and CSS assets updates

1.4.7

  • Update – Revisit all plugin text and translators

1.4.6

  • Update – Performance and optimization compatibility

1.4.5

  • New – Add compact mode toggle under settings option
  • Update – Compatibility check with WordPress 6.7
  • Update – Language file (.pot)
  • Update – Language file (.pot) header text
  • Update – Change license files to use GPLv3

1.4.4

  • Update – Replace all php files end of line sequence from CRLF to LF.
  • Update – Don’t show up the rating notice when toggle plugin activate/deactivate.
  • Update – Replace MLR_PLUGIN_DOMAIN with krasenslavov.com in Settings main page.
  • Update – Make _wpnonce standard throughout the plugin php and js files.
  • Update – Font weight variable for H2-H6 on the global Settings.
  • Update – Update the correct support ticket link with WFL_PLUGIN_WPORG_SUPPORT.
  • Update – Regenerate the .pot file.
  • Fix – Mismatched text domain.
  • Fix – Missing $domain parameter in function call.
